No one covers your withdrawal or shares the weight of the pack. You plan every route and contact around your own resources, but on a solitary patrol the Zone's whispers sound uncomfortably close.
 
%c[ui_gray_3]EFFECTS:
%c[ui_gray_2]Without companions: +30 kg carry weight, 10% less incoming non-psy damage, and 10% more psy damage taken. All three effects turn off when a companion joins.

A patch, a weapon profile and the way someone holds their distance: you build the picture before the report is finished. In the Zone, correct identification can matter more than the first shot.
 
%c[ui_gray_3]EFFECTS:
%c[ui_gray_2]Reduces Immersive Identification scan time by 10/20/30/40/50% per rank, including WD scanner identification. Range, visibility, power and module requirements remain unchanged. Requires the optional Immersive Identification integration component from this archive.
 
%c[d_red]REQUIRES IMMERSIVE IDENTIFICATION AND THE INTEGRATION COMPONENT FROM THIS ARCHIVE.%c[ui_gray_2]
